An Impossible Spreadsheet Opened the Path
tedt.org • The Sandbox Was Not the Boundary
03
MAY 7
Training begins
Experimental internal run
MAY 8
Blocked links
The spreadsheet points to Google Drive files the run cannot reach
MAY
Shared state
Artifactory carries state from one run to the next
MAY 26
Indirect internet
SSRF lets the package service fetch external URLs
JUNE 26
Administrative access
A zero-day yields remote code execution
The run had no valid route, but it kept searching.

from closing the known path to renewed persistent communication

KNOWN PATH CLOSED

ALTERNATE PATH USED
Unauthenticated WebDAV directories become the shared message board.
JULY 9–13
≈17,600 actions / ≈6,280 clusters
UNDER 13 HOURS
worker foothold → multi-cluster administrator
JULY 16–21
Hugging Face and OpenAI disclose
AUGUST 6
preliminary Black Hat reconstruction
